business_scope.primary_industry_name: Vacuum Freeze-Drying Manufacture of Organic Pet Treats and Meal Kibble

applicable_bilateral_investment_treaties: France–Germany Double Taxation Agreement (DTA) 1959, amended by Protocol 2015
France–United Kingdom DTA 2008, as modified by the 2021 Multilateral Instrument
France–China BIT 1984, terminated by mutual agreement? In force through EU framework
France–EU/EEA Treaty provisions on freedom of establishment
France–United States Double Taxation Convention 2006 (with later protocols)

ubo_and_aml_profiling.statutory_law_governance: Code monétaire et financier (CMF), Articles L.561-1 to L.561-57 and R.561-1 to R.561-58; Decree No. 2017-1094 (amended by Decree No. 2021-919): creation of the UBO register under Article L.561-45 CMF and R.561-53; Commercial Code, Articles R.123-3 and R.123-141 (RCS registration); Loi n° 2014-979 (Loi Sapin II); Directive (EU) 2015/849 as transposed by Ordonnance n° 2020-115, implementing AMLD4/5 obligations with TRACFIN as FIU.

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Passport or valid national ID of each beneficial owner and manager
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Issuing authority in the owner's country of residence (e.g., Ministry of Interior, consulate)
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Hague Apostille from the competent authority of the country of origin; if the country is not a Hague member, Consular Legalization at the French Embassy

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Certificate of Incorporation and Articles of Association of any corporate parent entity
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Tax/company registry of the parent company's jurisdiction
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Hague Apostille or Consular Legalization as above

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Bank reference letter, credit rating report, and proof of source of funds
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Qualified financial institution in the owner's country
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Hague Apostille or Consular Legalization as above; must date within 3 months before filing

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Certificate of tax residence or tax identification document of the beneficial owner
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Hague Apostille or Consular Legalization as above

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Power of Attorney appointing the French statutory representative (if any)
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Notary public in the jurisdiction of origin
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Hague Apostille or Consular Legalization; must be signed before a competent notary

ubo_and_aml_profiling.pep_and_sanctions_screening_protocols: Mandatory screening of all beneficial owners, directors, and ultimate controllers against the EU Council Consolidated Financial Sanctions List, the French Treasury's list of frozen assets (DG Trésor), UN Security Council sanctions lists, the OFAC SDN List, and the French ACPR/TRACFIN guidance. The level of customer due diligence is standard ('Low_Risk_Standard') and includes identity verification, UBO identification, source-of-funds documentation, and continuous transaction monitoring. For PEPs, dedicated enhanced due diligence applies under CMF Article L.561-33, including the approval of senior management, stricter monitoring, and written justification of the business relationship.

statutory_name_clearance_protocol.registry_portal_name: Guichet des Formalités Entreprises (formalites.entreprises.gouv.fr) together with the official company registry portal Infogreffe (infogreffe.fr) and the intellectual property database of the INPI (inpi.fr).
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.language_and_transliteration_doctrine: Company names (dénomination sociale) must be legal in France and are always transcribed in the Latin script. French is the mandatory register language; a foreign-language name is accepted if transliterated in Latin and if the French spelling is filed in the RCS. Names containing numbers or symbols are permitted but must be clearly identifiable for legal publication; a phonetic search is performed to prevent deceptive similarity with existing RCS entries or registered trademarks.
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.extension_and_rejection_appeal_sop: Upon name rejection, a written appeal must be lodged with the Greffier du Tribunal de Commerce (Registry Clerk) within 15 days of the rejection notification, or alternatively the applicant may file a judicial challenge before the commercial court. A preliminary courtesy search at INPI for existing domain IDs and trademarks is recommended before filing. If rejection is based on a conflicting trademark, the applicant may obtain consent, withdraw the conflicting rights, or design a new distinctive name. The business registration file is rejected as a whole, but no appeal fee applies to the administrative level; court costs may arise if the case is appealed to the civil division of the Tribunal Judiciaire.

registered_office_and_commercial_substan.virtual_office_permissibility: Virtual offices are generally not acceptable for a manufacturing SARL. French law allows 'domiciliation' by a commercial distributing company (société de domiciliation) under Commercial Code Articles L.123-21-1 and D.123-200, but the arrangement must be anchored to a physical address in France. Since the business scope covers vacuum freeze-drying of pet food, which is a food-processing activity subject to approval under EU Regulation 852/2004 and the French Public Health Code, a genuine industrial site with a designated building, machinery, cold storage, and food-safety laboratory is statutorily required. Pure virtual-office registration is therefore not permitted; a domiciliation agreement is only usable for limited administrative purposes and does not satisfy the substance test for the manufacturing permit.
registered_office_and_commercial_substan.physical_inspection_likelihood: Quantified risk of unannounced physical inspection is 85% within the first year of operation, due to French food-safety and anti-fraud enforcement by the DDPP (Direction départementale de la protection des populations) and DGAL (Direction générale de l'alimentation), whose inspection cadence does not give advance notice.

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Commercial name availability certificate (certificat de dénomination) and RCS preliminary negative search
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.charging_authority: Greffe du Tribunal de Commerce (Registry of the Commercial Court)
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Statutory tariff fixed by the Direction des Affaires Civiles et du Sceau (current average €85)

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Registration fee for SARL at the Greffe (RCS betting)
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Statutory fee schedule for a SARL with capital under 250,000 EUR (decree 2006-1382)

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Publication of the statutory legal notice in a French legal gazette (JAL)
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Market rate, typically €300 for a 45-line notice in larger commercial cities

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Drafting of articles of association (statuts) and appointment of a statutory auditor, if required
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.charging_authority: CADA Law Firm or Paris Bar certified M&A/corporate lawyer
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Prevailing market benchmark: €2,000 plus VAT for a standard SARL with two shareholders and no capital/equity accounting complexity

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Certified translation of UBO and incorporation documents from English, Chinese, or other foreign languages into French
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.charging_authority: Certified legal translator / translator sworn at an appeal court
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Per certified page €80, minimum 5 pages, actual cost guaranteed

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Notarial certification of passports and reserved name record (if required by the bank)
Hague Apostille expediting fees (three documents from home jurisdiction)
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.charging_authority: Competent Apostille authority in the jurisdiction of origin (e.g., Secretary of State, Ministry of Foreign Affairs)
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Per-document administration fee varying from USD 20 to USD 75, expedited handling

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: French bank account opening and AML/KYC compliance handling fee
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.charging_authority: Candidate commercial bank (e.g., BNP Paribas, Crédit Agricole, Société Générale)
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Bank pricing as published; includes AML analysis, UBO disclosure, and account maintenance for one year

incorporation_legal_framework.governing_statute_and_sections: French Civil Code (Code civil) articles 1832 et seq.; French Commercial Code (Code de commerce) Book II, Title III: articles L.210-1 to L.210-10, L.223-1 to L.223-43, R.210-1 to R.223-43 and applied implementing decrees, principally Décret n°2007-431.
incorporation_legal_framework.competent_registry_authority: Greffe du Tribunal de Commerce having territorial jurisdiction over the registered office; maintains the Registre du Commerce et des Sociétés (RCS). Official digital gateway: Guichet des formalités des entreprises.
incorporation_legal_framework.statutory_filing_instrument: Statuts (Articles of Association) together with the official registration application (Cerfa M0 or equivalent digital module) and Déclaration des bénéficiaires effectifs (beneficial ownership declaration).
incorporation_legal_framework.minimum_paid_up_capital_rule: For an SARL no statutory minimum share capital is required. The capital must be fully subscribed; cash contributions must be at least 20% paid up at incorporation and the remainder within five years. In-kind contributions must be fully paid up on formation. Cash contributions are deposited in a bank or notary account and blocked until the company receives its Kbis extract (Code de commerce, articles L.223-7 and R.223-5).
incorporation_legal_framework.pro_forma_first_board_resolution_en: FIRST BOARD RESOLUTION. The shareholders of [COMPANY] S.A.R.L. unanimously resolve: (1) Share subscription — the capital of EUR ____ divided into ____ equal shares is fully subscribed; the required cash contributions are approved as paid up; (2) Registered office — the registered office is fixed at [address], France; the Manager is instructed to complete all RCS formalities; (3) Officers — [NAME] is appointed Manager (gérant) for an indefinite term with broadest powers to represent the company; (4) Authorisation — the Manager shall deposit funds, publish legal notice, obtain Kbis, and file all necessary tax, social, and pet-food licensing applications. This resolution is effective immediately.

step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Institut National de la Propriété Industrielle (INPI) databases and the RCS via Infogreffe.
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Search the INPI company name and trademark database and the RCS register to confirm that the proposed corporate name is available and does not infringe existing prior rights. If desired, file a French trademark application with INPI for distinctive name protection. Record the search results in a formal clearance memo before proceeding.
required_dossiers: INPI trademark search / registration certificate if filed
Draft Article 2 of Statuts containing the corporate name
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If an identical or confusingly similar name is found, select a different name or obtain a written coexistence consent from the prior rights holder. Trademark oppositions can be settled by negotiation before RCS filing.

step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Founding shareholders (associés), optionally assisted by a notaire where real-property contributions are made.
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Draft French-language Statuts setting out the legal form SARL, company name, registered office, corporate object covering vacuum freeze-drying of organic pet raw meat, duration, share capital, nominal value of shares, subscription terms, manager appointment and powers, profit distribution rules and dispute resolution clauses. Have all shareholders initial each page and sign the final document. Where a contribution consists of real property, have the Statuts notarized.
required_dossiers: Passport or national identity card of each shareholder
Proof of address for each shareholder
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the Greffe or a notary identifies invalid clauses, convene an extraordinary shareholders' meeting and execute a rectification deed. Any missing translation must be provided by a certified translator and refiled.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Share Capital Deposit and Bank Attestation
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: A French licensed credit institution or a notaire acting as deposit holder.
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Open a provisional account in the name of the SARL under formation or a notary escrow account. Deposit the total amount of cash contributions and ensure that at least 20% of the cash capital is paid in. For in-kind contributions, ensure a contribution auditor's report or commissioner's report on asset valuation is prepared. Obtain the banker's attestation de blocage confirming the funds are blocked until the Kbis extract is issued.
required_dossiers: In-kind contribution valuation report if applicable
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the bank refuses account opening on AML grounds, invoke the Banque de France 'droit au compte' procedure to have a bank assigned. If the notary or bank refuses release, await the issue of the Kbis as the release condition.

step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: A journal d'annonces légales (JAL) authorized in the department of the registered office.
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Prepare a French-language legal notice stating the corporate form SARL, company name, share capital, registered office, corporate object, duration, manager name and RCS registration to be requested. Submit the text to the JAL and pay publication fees. Obtain the attestation de parution after insertion.
required_dossiers: Proof of payment to the legal gazette
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the legal notice is rejected because of substantive or formal errors, correct and refile. If an error is detected after publication, arrange for a corrective notice and attach the correction to the RCS application.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: RCS Registration Application (Immatriculation au Registre du Commerce et des Sociétés)
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Greffe du Tribunal de Commerce of the registered office, through the Guichet des formalités des entreprises.
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Complete the national online registration form with company particulars and attach the signed Statuts, bank deposit certificate, attestation de parution, registered office occupancy proof, beneficial owner declaration, manager's declaration of non-conviction, identity documents and any required legalized translations. Submit the dossier electronically and pay the registration fee. The Greffe will examine the file and register the SARL.
required_dossiers: Attestation de parution from the legal gazette
Justificatif de jouissance du local (lease or utility bill)
Manager identity and declaration of no convictions
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the Greffe issues a non-compliance request, submit the missing documents online within fifteen working days. If registration is refused on material grounds, amend the Statuts by shareholder resolution and refile without re-publication if the defect is formal.

step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Greffe du Tribunal de Commerce, INSEE (SIRENE), DGFiP and URSSAF.
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: After registration, obtain the official Kbis extract confirming legal existence. The SIREN/SIRET numbers are issued automatically by INSEE. Verify that the company is registered for VAT with DGFiP, including intra-Community VAT if applicable. Open an employer account with URSSAF using the Kbis and SIRET number. Open the definitive company bank account and file all banking mandates.
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If SIREN/SIRET issuance is delayed, contact INSEE/Infogreffe for acceleration. If URSSAF does not automatically create the employer account, register online using the Kbis and manager credentials.

step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Manager and shareholders collectively; no external filing required except with the RCS if share transfer records are rectified.
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: After the Kbis is received, open the corporate books: the statutory share register (registre des mouvements de titres), minutes of shareholders' meetings / general decisions, and the beneficial owners register. If employees are hired, open the personnel register and apply standard French employment formalities. Ensure that the initial board resolution and share subscription lists are filed in the corporate records.
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If corporate records are found incomplete during an audit or later filing, prepare rectification resolutions signed by all shareholders. Share transfer omissions can be cured by a retroactive registration in the share register, provided no prejudice to third parties occurs.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.competent_industrial_authority: Direction Départementale de la Protection des Populations (DDPP) / Direction Départementale de l'Emploi, du Travail et des Solidarités (DDETSPP), under the French Ministry of Agriculture and Food Sovereignty, supported by DGCCRF.
industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.operating_license_title: Agrément sanitaire / Enregistrement en tant qu'opérateur du secteur de l'alimentation animale et de sous-produits animaux — approbation for the production of freeze-dried pet food containing raw meat under Regulation (EC) No 183/2005, Regulation (EC) No 1069/2009 and Commission Regulation (EU) No 142/2011.

environmental_impact_assessment_eia.agency_name: Direction Régionale de l'Environnement, de l'Aménagement et du Logement (DREAL), within the Ministère de la Transition Écologique, with input from DDPP for hygienic and animal by-product issues.
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.classification_tier: ICPE (Installations Classées pour la Protection de l'Environnement): likely Enregistrement under Rubrique 2730 or 2731 for animal by-product storage / processing below authorization thresholds; a full Autorisation Environnementale with an EIA / environmental impact assessment may be required if processing capacities exceed thresholds under Code de l'environnement articles L.181-1 et seq. and R.512-46.
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.discharge_and_emissions_standards: Industrial wastewater pre-treatment before municipal discharge respecting Cod. env. L.210-1, L.214-1 et seq. and local PNEC limits. Air emissions, including VOCs and odours, must comply with Order of 2 February 1998 and EU Directive 2010/75/EU. Animal by-product handling, pasteurization/sterilization and waste traceability must meet EU Regulation 142/2011 Annexes.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.civil_defense_and_occupational_clearance: Fire safety certification by an accredited bureau (APAVE or Bureau Veritas) in accordance with the Code de la construction et de l'habitation for industrial premises; structural load inspection of freezer/dryer floor zones; employee workplace clearance under the Code du travail, completion of the Document Unique d'Évaluation des Risques, verification of pressure vessels, electrical installations, ventilation and refrigeration systems, and registration with the local fire and occupational safety authorities.

mandatory_customs_documentation_bundle: Customs Export Declaration (Déclaration en Douane via DELTA X)
Bill of Lading or Air Waybill
Inward Remittance Certificate (Attestation de Rapatriement des Devises)

fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.central_bank_authority: Banque de France (Bank of France) as monetary, balance-of-payments, and banking supervisor; Direction Générale du Trésor (DG Trésor / French Treasury) within the Ministry of Economy for foreign investment screening, international capital movement policy and financial sanctions; European Central Bank (ECB) in the Eurosystem for monetary policy and TARGET2 settlement.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.currency_convertibility_assessment: France operates a full-convertibility regime under Article 63 TFEU and Articles L151-1 et seq. of the Code monétaire et financier; there is no administrative segmentation of current and capital account transactions, and both categories are freely effected without central-bank approval. The EUR is a fully convertible reserve currency. For profit remittance, a SARL may distribute dividends only after formal annual approval of the financial statements; the withheld flat tax on distributions is 30% in the ordinary domestic case (12.8% income tax plus 17.2% social levies), which may be reduced under the applicable double tax treaty for the foreign shareholder, and the payment is free of trade-control licenses or FX permits. The only operational hurdles are: (i) correct classification of the remittance in the Banque de France balance-of-payments (BR) reporting; (ii) proof that the distribution complies with the SARL's distributable profits; and (iii) for non-EU shareholders, the standard bank compliance and source-of-funds documentation.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.export_proceeds_surrender_rules: No statutory export-proceeds surrender or mandatory conversion requirement exists in France; export receipts in foreign currency may be credited to a designated foreign-currency account and retained indefinitely (0% mandatory conversion ratio, no statutory conversion timeline). The only binding obligations are statistical: French residents must, through their appointed credit institution, document all cross-border settlements for the Banque de France balance-of-payments, with transaction-by-transaction reporting generally applied to movements of EUR 50,000 or more; corporations generating annual aggregate cross-border settlements of EUR 50 million or more are subject to direct monthly declarations. For a freeze-dried pet-food SARL, retaining the export invoice package (French customs export declarations, Bill of Lading/CMR, EU veterinary certificates, commercial invoices) is essential to substantiate each receipt and to support a clean BR reporting line.

corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.fintech_emi_cross_border_viability: Feasibility: HIGH for operational collections, e-commerce/seller-platform settlements, payroll, and small inbound/outbound payments via EU-passported e-money institutions (Wise, Revolut Business, Qonto, SumUp); the French market recognizes passports under PSD2, but passported EMIs should nevertheless be verified in the ORIAS registry or by the Banque de France notification status. Feasibility: LOW as a substitute for statutory capital escrow: under French law, the incorporation deposit certificate (certificat du dépositaire des fonds / attestation de dépôt des fonds) used to open the SARL and obtain the Kbis must be issued by a licensed credit institution, the Caisse des Dépôts et Consignations, or a notary; a pure EMI license is not accepted. Additional constraints: EMIs cannot issue the bank reference letters required by landlords, insurers, or certain B2B customers, and their counterparty transaction-screening is often narrower, which may create friction for large raw-meat trade settlements. Recommended architecture: Tier-1 French bank as the treasury master account and capital escrow depositary, with one EU EMI as a collection/currency-conversion side pocket subject to daily cash sweeps into the French master account.
corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.physical_presence_and_kyc_interview_mand: Most mainstream French banks require at least one high-assurance physical or video-identification event for the SARL's manager (gérant) and any authorized signatory. Remote video KYC is increasingly accepted by digital channels (e.g., BNP HelloBusiness, Société Générale by internet/phone appointment) but normally only for EU-domiciled individuals holding a national ID or passport. Non-EU or non-resident directors/managers should plan for a physical branch interview in France or, alternatively, a visit by a bank officer to the registered office; remote-only opening is unusual for a non-resident SARL. The bank will require the original or certified copy of the Kbis extract, the executed 'statuts' (articles of association), the beneficial-owner declaration, the capital-deposit attestation where applicable, proof of registered office, and passport/identity details of all UBOs. A simple operational account typically takes two to four weeks to open; a multi-currency account with letters of credit or hedging facilities can take four to eight weeks.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Opaque ultimate beneficial ownership (e.g., foreign corporate shareholder or nominee structure)
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Apostilled/legalized corporate registry extracts and identity documents for every direct or indirect 25%-or-more shareholder; completed French 'Déclaration des bénéficiaires effectifs' (UBO) filed with the Registre du Commerce; group structure chart up to natural persons; notarized powers of attorney and corporate resolutions appointing the gérant; bank reference letters from the overseas shareholder's institution.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Source-of-wealth mismatch for injected capital or unexplained advance payments from platform sales
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Full source-of-funds file: shareholder tax returns or dividend vouchers, sale/liquidity-event agreements, three to six months of bank statements from the remitting bank, accountant-reviewed financial statements of the shareholder, and written capital-contribution resolutions for each founder's equity injection.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Sector red flag on perishable meat supply and animal-health compliance (risk of prohibited imports or mislabelled goods)
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: EU veterinary and DGAL import/slaughter authorizations, HACCP plan, signed freeze-drying production facility lease, traceability records for raw meat batches, supplier contracts naming approved farms/abattoirs, import health certificates, French customs entries, and contamination/product-liability insurance certificates.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Expected high-velocity E-commerce marketplace collections (Etsy/Amazon) with rapid payout to foreign suppliers
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Marketplace seller contracts and payout statements, standard commercial terms, invoice reconciliation reports, ERP-generated order-to-cash logs, CMR/BoL transport documents matching each disbursement, and an approved board-level treasury and cash-sweep policy.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Tax-domicile divergence — central management allegedly exercised from abroad although the SARL is French-tax-resident
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Physical registered-office lease (bail commercial), payroll and URSSAF filings, employment contracts for operational staff, minutes of board/gérant decisions made in France, EIG/ORIAS registrations, electricity/telephony/insurance contracts, and evidence that vacuum freeze-drying production actually takes place in France.

cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.inbound_capital_injection_routing: Compliant mechanism: (a) the foreign shareholder remits via SWIFT MT103 (TARGET2 or SEPA Credit Transfer acceptable for EU shareholders) to the SARL's dedicated capital escrow or operational account; (b) purpose code in field 70/77B uses ISO 20022 'CAPC' (Capital Payments) for equity contributions or 'FINS' for shareholder loans, and the remittance advice must cross-reference the SARL corporate name, the subscription agreement, and the intended share registry entry; (c) the receiving bank requires a gérant certification that the funds are free of third-party rights, together with the French BR 'nature d'opération' mapping (direct foreign investment equity category for share capital; associate-loan category for a 'compte courant d'associé'); (d) for non-EU inbound investments, verify that the activity does not fall within France's strategic-sector screening regime (régime des investissements étrangers en France) — freeze-dried pet raw-meat manufacturing is non-sensitive, so no prior authorization is expected, but post-closing declarations and documentary preservation are prudent; (e) verification: upon receipt, the bank issues the capital-deposit attestation or an account statement needed by the notary/CPE to complete the definitive Kbis. No French foreign-exchange permit or central-bank approval is required; the capital injection is simply reported through the BR statistics in the relevant month.
cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.outbound_trade_disbursements: Preferred clearing rails: (i) SEPA Credit Transfer / SEPA Instant for EUR-denominated EU suppliers, executed within seconds for early-payment discounts; (ii) SWIFT MT103 for non-EU suppliers in the USA, UK, South America, or Asia, with invoice and customs references in field 70; (iii) documentary commercial Letters of Credit (UCP600, irrevocable, confirmed by a Tier-1 bank) for high-value frozen raw-meat consignments under Incoterms 2020 (FOB, CIF, or CFR), payable at sight against compliant documents (commercial invoice, veterinary/phytosanitary certificates, negotiable bill of lading); (iv) Bank Payment Obligation (BPO) under URBPO rules as an open-account alternative for recurring structured flows; (v) Platform Pay and card-based settlement rails for Etsy/Amazon/shopify disbursements, with proceeds swept daily to the corporate treasury account. Every outbound disbursement must retain the underlying purchase order, commercial invoice, and delivery receipt to support customs clearance, balance-of-payments reporting, and transfer-pricing documentation where the counterparty is related.
permissible_fx_hedging_instruments: EUR/USD and EUR/GBP forward outrights (non-speculative; maturity up to 12 months; backed by signed purchase orders or sales contracts)
EUR/USD and EUR/GBP FX swaps (spot-forward rollovers for timing mismatches between export receipts and supplier payments)
Cross-currency basis swaps (EUR/USD, EUR/GBP) for long-term capex or supplier financing with notional and maturity aligned to the underlying trade flow
Non-deliverable forwards (NDFs) on EUR/CNH, EUR/BRL, EUR/COP and other soft currencies where physical delivery is impractical, supported by trade documentation
Vanilla FX options (EUR/USD, EUR/GBP) on a bought-premium basis only, used to cap adverse rate movements without speculative naked-writing positions

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual financial statements filing (dépôt des comptes annuels) — balance sheet, income statement, notes, management report, and statutory auditor's report if appointed; accompanied by the statutory greffe registration fee.
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Greffe du Tribunal de Commerce via Infogreffe and the Registry of Companies (RCS).
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Within 7 months of fiscal year-end; for a calendar-year SARL closing on 31 December, filing is due by 31 July of the following year.
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Court-ordered injunction on the Public Prosecutor's motion with daily periodic penalty (astreinte) for continued default; criminal fine up to EUR 9,000 against the manager; after sustained non-compliance the company may be involuntarily struck off (radiation d'office) from the commercial register.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Ordinary Annual General Meeting (Assemblée Générale Ordinaire Annuelle) approving the prior-year annual accounts, allocating the result (including the 5% legal reserve until reaching 10% of share capital), and granting discharge to the managers; minutes entered in the company's decisions register.
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Shareholders' meeting of the SARL — corporate corporate-governance body; minutes are internal statutory books, not filed with any governmental agency.
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Within 6 months of fiscal year-end; for a calendar-year SARL, the meeting must be held by 30 June of the following year.
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Criminal fine of up to EUR 9,000 for the managing director (C. com. L. 241-5); shareholders may petition the commercial court to appoint an agent to convene the meeting; the failure to hold the AGEA does not cure the subsequent lateness of the annual accounts deposit.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual corporate income tax return (liasse fiscale) — form 2065-SD with annexes 2066-SD to 2069-SD, including the international transactions and transfer-pricing file (form 2257-SD) where applicable.
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Direction Générale des Finances Publiques (DGFiP) — Service des Impôts des Entreprises, filed online through the professional tax portal.
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: For a calendar-year SARL, the second business day following 1 May (normally 2 May); for a non-calendar fiscal year, within 3 months of the closing date.
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: 10% surcharge (majoration) if the return is filed more than 30 days after the formal reminder (mise en demeure); late-payment interest at 0.20% per month; 40% penalty for intentional defective filing and 80% for concealment or fraudulent manoeuvres; enforced recovery by garnishment.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual local business property levy — Cotisation Foncière des Entreprises (CFE): annual return form 1447-C-SD and payment of the balance. The former CVAE (contribution on value added) is repealed from fiscal year 2024 by the 2024 Finance Act.
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: DGFiP and local municipal tax offices; payment enforced through avis de mise en recouvrement.
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Declaration in May of the assessment year; balance of the annual CFE due on 15 December of the same calendar year.
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: 10% late-payment surcharge plus 0.20% per month interest; enforced recovery through a formal collection notice and, in continued default, seizure of bank accounts or movables; no direct strike-off impact.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual confirmation of the Register of Beneficial Owners (Registre des Bénéficiaires Effectifs — RBE): update and re-file any change in direct or indirect beneficial ownership exceeding the 25% threshold; the register is cross-checked at each annual accounts filing.
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Greffe du Tribunal de Commerce and the INPI Guichet Unique (e-formalités portal).
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Within 30 days of any triggering change in beneficial ownership; no separate fixed calendar deadline for the confirmation other than the moment of the annual accounts filing or any registration update.
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Criminal fine up to EUR 7,500 and 6 months' imprisonment for directors who deliberately fail to file truthful RBE information; the registry may refuse or flag the annual accounts filing where the beneficial owner position is inconsistent.

statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.compulsory_audit_thresholds: A SARL is subject to mandatory independent audit (Commissaire aux Comptes) when it exceeds at least two of the three thresholds at fiscal year-end: balance-sheet total above EUR 4 million (approx. USD 4.3 million), net turnover excluding tax above EUR 8 million (approx. USD 8.6 million), or average permanent workforce above 50 employees (Decree No. 2019-514). Audit is also compulsory where the company belongs to a group required to consolidate or where shareholders holding at least 10% of capital petition the court to appoint an auditor.
statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.governing_accounting_framework: French GAAP: ANC Règlement N°2014-03 (Plan Comptable Général — PCG), with the abbreviated presentation regime for micro and small companies; IFRS is optional only for consolidated financial statements; freeze-dried pet-food inventory is measured under PCG work-in-progress and finished-goods rules at the lower of cost or net realisable value.

corporate_registers_and_ubo_annual_confi.ubo_annual_confirmation_protocol: France does not impose a stand-alone annual UBO return. The Register of Beneficial Owners is maintained with the Commercial Court Registry and must reflect any change within 30 days of a triggering transfer or shareholding increase above the 25% threshold. The annual deposit of accounts serves as the de facto yearly confirmation moment: the registry cross-checks the RBE records against the filing and flags the dossier where the beneficial owner position is missing or inconsistent. Deliberate omission is a criminal offence.

recurring_annual_maintenance_budget_usd.registered_office_or_agent_market_range_: USD 700-2,000 per annum (Paris and premium law-firm secretariats: USD 1,500-4,000) for professional registered-office domiciliation and corporate secretarial support covering AG convening, registry formalities, and RBE updates.
recurring_annual_maintenance_budget_usd.statutory_audit_estimated_fee_usd: USD 5,000-15,000 for a full statutory audit mandate by a registered commissaire aux comptes on an ISIC 1080 production SARL; USD 3,000-6,500 where the thresholds are not exceeded and only a limited review or voluntary auditor mission is engaged.
